description: This file defines a class 'Converters' containing methods annotated with @TypeConverter for converting custom data types to and from formats suitable for storage in a Room database. It includes conversions for Date, EventType, and LeaveType.

classes.name: Converters
classes.description: A utility class providing type conversion methods for Room database, handling conversion between custom types and database-compatible formats.

methods.name: fromTimestamp
methods.description: Converts a Long timestamp to a Date object.

methods.name: dateToTimestamp
methods.description: Converts a Date object to its Long timestamp representation.

methods.name: fromEventType
methods.description: Converts an EventType enum to its String name.

methods.name: toEventType
methods.description: Converts a String to an EventType enum.

methods.name: fromLeaveType
methods.description: Converts a LeaveType enum to its String name.

methods.name: toLeaveType
methods.description: Converts a String to a LeaveType enum.
